description: Keeps the shell's pre-existing custom commands working for LOCAL origins (the bundled tauri://localhost / http://tauri.localhost pages such as connect.html and cert-trust.html) once build.rs registers an AppManifest. Before the manifest, Tauri implicitly allowed every custom command from a local origin; with one, each needs an explicit allow-*. This capability is deliberately local-only (no `remote.urls`, so the loopback/remote Panel gains nothing), covers every window as before, and lists exactly the nine legacy commands - no wildcard, and none of the panel_credential_* commands (those are granted only by the runtime capability that keyring_bridge::install adds).
